content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal provide convenient payment processing solutions but come with geographic limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, leaving many creators without access. PayPal offers robust features but can suspend accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also impose geographical restrictions, limiting the ability of digital creators in specific regions to market their products effectively. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a comprehensive solution that eliminates these limitations, allowing creators to set up their own stores with full control over payments and delivery.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, traditional platforms often exclude large markets due to regulatory concerns and risk management. This systemic exclusion means that creators in places like Nigeria and Pakistan are often forced to find workarounds, which can lead to unreliable income streams. These platforms do not provide support for creators operating outside their chosen markets, effectively locking them out. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH, does not discriminate based on geography. It offers creators in restricted countries the tools to build, manage, and profit from their digital products without relying on third-party platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing speed varies significantly across platforms. Stripe and PayPal can hold funds for extended periods, which affects cash flow for creators. In contrast, NOWPayments integrated into sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that payments are processed on-chain almost instantly, with fees as low as 0.5%. Conventional platforms often charge higher transaction fees and impose additional costs for currency conversion. By utilizing sovereign commerce stacks, creators bypass these pitfalls, enjoying lower fees and faster access to their revenue without the risk of account freezes or holds.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor that distinguishes sovereign commerce infrastructure from traditional platforms. With Stripe or PayPal, creators often relinquish control of their customer data and revenue streams. In contrast, once deployed, COREMERCH solutions allow full ownership of all aspects of the store, including customer interactions and transaction histories. Automation is another strong point; using tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase ensures that order management and digital delivery are seamless and efficient. Creators can set up their systems to deliver products automatically upon payment confirmation, freeing them to focus on content creation.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture for selling digital products hinges on the creator's location and specific needs. For those in countries excluded from major payment processors, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the clear victor. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is particularly beneficial as it’s designed to deploy quickly, with features tailored to address common pain points. By implementing Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, creators benefit from low fees and rapid deployment. This approach provides a permanent structural alternative to the unreliable foundations of conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Eliminate payment processor restrictions by choosing a self-hosted solution.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction with no hidden costs, making it a cost-effective solution compared to traditional payment processors that may impose higher fees.
Is it possible to automate product delivery?
Yes, integrating tools like Cloudflare Workers allows you to automate product delivery upon payment confirmation, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers.
